final: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals), combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT c.*, c.avg_optvolrt - b.avg_optvolrt AS deviation FROM combinations AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT d.tradekind, AVG(d.avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(d.deviation - a.avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > a.avg_deviation GROUP BY d.tradekind
